fundamental.text: Solana is clearly alive and shipping. In September it activated Transaction V1 (larger transactions), cut slot time to 250ms and began activating Alpenglow, a new consensus that targets ~150ms finality, on testnet (week of 22 Sep) and devnet (25 Sep). No mainnet Alpenglow date is confirmed. The weak spot is value capture: most fee generation still comes from memecoin trading apps (PumpSwap, Axiom, GMGN, pump.fun), and Blockworks-reported network REV fell 43% in Q2 2026. Real-world usage is improving through stablecoins ($17B) and RWAs such as BlackRock BUIDL. Two operational risks from 2026 stay on the record: the $285M Drift exploit in April and a hosting-provider routing fault on 12 Aug that pushed 28.8% of stake offline and came within 4.5 points of halting finality.

Value accrual to SOL depends on priority fees and MEV tips, which fell in Q2 and have only partly recovered.

fundamental.text: Chainlink is still the default oracle for DeFi and is building steadily into banking infrastructure. September brought real launches: Data Streams and CCIP went live on Circle's Arc mainnet (Sep 15-16). DTCC's Collateral AppChain is expected in Q4 2026. The Infosys deal announced on Sep 22 is a distribution agreement only. It names no bank, gives no timeline and commits to no fees, so count it as a pipeline item, not usage. tokenomics.text: About 748M of 1B LINK circulate, so roughly 252M remains with the team or foundation. Those wallets release LINK every quarter. Monthly buybacks of about 0.4M LINK are an order of magnitude below unlocks of about 6-7M LINK a month. Net supply is still inflating.
